# Welcome

This vault is a folder of plain Markdown files. Open [Markdown tour](Markdown%20tour.md) to see what the editor shows as you type.

- **Work** holds projects and meeting notes.
- **Personal** holds lists and ideas.
- **Recipes** holds things to cook.

Pinned notes like this one stay at the top of the list.
